note: RV park beside the Big Brutus mining-shovel museum in West Mineral, run by Big Brutus, Inc., a nonprofit. The campground opened around 2024: level gravel pull-throughs, some full hookups and some water/electric, with no trees or picnic tables. There is a bathhouse with showers. Touring the shovel costs extra (museum admission). --Claude
